I am 31 years old. I have a university degree with applied information technologies.
I started my programming carrier couple years ago with a commercial project - a site for restaurant. After I was changed to backend (Java), then went back to JS, made some freelance projects, but never was a full-time professional programmer.
Currently I`m working in a related industry, writing programs for metallurgical machining centers. I’ve just recalled my past passion for web programming and want to brush up on my skills.
